Session budget: 2^20 records/direction, 30 minutes; retirement is terminal.
SessionSlot is the single serialisation point of a relation and witnesses itself; retiring a slot reclaims its lock entry and the replacement carries the next lease generation.
No external review/model/content/device result may be fabricated.
Mesh advertising is UUID-only (canonical service UUID + flags); the 13-octet LinkInfo record is served by GATT and the air payload is budget-audited before dispatch.
GATT profile is contract-driven on both engines (Generated A001-A004; legacy FD01/FD02 removed and refused; digest characteristic parity added to the Android server).

Android scan callbacks are context-bound (ScanContext epoch/identity/lease; capture-before-deliver; reducer-only mutation) and the discovery surface is bounded (64, pin-aware, deterministic LRU eviction) on both the transport and the orchestration driver.

Android terminal events (reject, timeout, local cancel) complete explicitly via the driver terminate authority: exact RelationKey transitions, once-leased, once-unpublished, captured-handle closes; production callbacks carry required tokens; late platform terminals are idempotent.

iOS transport epochs own their manager pair: every opening builds a fresh CBCentralManager/CBPeripheralManager pair with its own delegate proxies on a dedicated serial queue, wired once at birth; the reducer authenticates sender instance, wired delegate and named epoch together - events of closed epochs are dropped where they stand.

iOS transport reduces each manager event as one uninterrupted operation on the epoch serial executor: validation, transition and effect scheduling never split; the lifecycle quiesces its epochs on the same queues, callback adapters deliver under their own context marker, and sealing and opening (trust work) never run while the transport lock is held - their completions re-check the admission token on the executor before any effect commits or the delegate is notified.

iOS timers are leases: TimerKey(relation, operation kind, unique id) names every window; storage, cancellation and replacement run only through reducer bodies on the epoch executor comparing whole keys before removing anything; the operation id source is monotone for the transport lifetime and deadlines are computed against the injected MonotonicClock; the connect advance re-arms through the same reducer.

an inbound subscription is a lease over the presented CBCentral: the actual handle is retained with the lease and responder notifications answer to it alone; unsubscribes are filtered by characteristic and matched against the generation the request carries; an ambiguity quarantines the identity for the epoch and only rotation of the manager context releases it - quarantine and admission histories are bounded, and an exhausted budget rotates a fully drained context, never a busy one; didFailToConnect is terminal without a disconnect request.
